events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Bangers
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your top track from the man himself, whether it's Oasis, Beady Eye, or his solo work?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975, four years after its album debut.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' single hit the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as powerfully today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's the John Lennon song that resonates most with you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The comedy icon and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from the comedy legend?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring classics like 'Norwegian Wood', was released 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: 61 years of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul'! This album changed everything. What's your go-to track from this iconic record?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate globally. We're thinking of him today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and legacy of the legendary David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Remembering the incredible artistry and influence of David Bowie. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. His music still moves us. What's your top Elvis track?
